name: John Calvin
bio: A central figure of the Protestant Reformation, Calvin was a pastor, theologian, and reformer based mainly in Geneva. He systematized Reformed theology in his famous Institutes of the Christian Religion.

name: Herman Bavinck
bio: One of the greatest Reformed theologians of the modern era, Bavinck combined deep orthodoxy with intellectual engagement with modern philosophy and culture.

name: Louis Berkhof
bio: A systematic theologian known for making Reformed theology clear, organized, and accessible. He taught at Calvin Theological Seminary.

name: Geerhardus Johannes Vos
bio: A pioneer of biblical theology, Vos emphasized the progressive unfolding of God's revelation in Scripture and its Christ-centered focus.

name: John Owen
bio: A prominent Puritan theologian and pastor, Owen is known for his writings on sanctification, the Trinity, and the nature of sin.

name: John Charles Ryle
bio: An evangelical Anglican bishop known for clear, practical, and pastoral writing accessible to ordinary Christians.

name: R.C. Sproul
bio: A modern Reformed theologian, teacher, and founder of Ligonier Ministries. Known for making deep theology understandable.
